First real CI run (head 90fcdfb, after a GitHub update-branch because Dependabot ignored the rebase comment) failed every job at `npm ci` in site/: @astrojs/check@0.9.10 declares peer typescript ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0, so TS 7 cannot install.
